name: Four Lanes
hint: One friend per lane, one rope for all. Every plate opens somebody else's gate.
why4: Each player is sealed in their own lane and every lane gate is held open by a plate in a different lane, so all four lanes must be manned.
solution: Each player starts in their own lane: P1 top, P2, P3, P4 bottom. Leash 7: the lanes are 3 apart, so nobody gets more than ~13 tiles ahead of the rest; every plate is placed for that.
P4 stands on the plate at x=5 (lane 4): gate A (lane 1, x=7) opens. P1 walks through and stands on the plate at x=9: gate E (lane 2) opens.
P2 walks through E and stands on the plate at x=9: gate F (lane 3) opens. P3 walks through F and stands on the plate at x=9: gate G (lane 4) opens.
P4 steps off (A closes behind P1), walks through G and stands on the plate at x=11: gate H (lane 1, x=14) opens.
P1 steps off (E closes behind P2), walks through H and touches the key at x=18. P2 and P3 step off their plates.
All four walk right together (leash); one by one they drop down the shaft at x=30-31 into lane 4 (stand still while falling, or you land a lane too high); P1 opens the door at x=40; all press Down.
